The main takeaway from our work is that

the encapsulation with poly(DL-LA) is very soft, with low surface tension and low surface dilational viscosity, and that the encapsulation properties can be determined using in vitro attenuation measurement.
the interfacial properties of PLA-coated microbubbles are different from those of lipids or proteins, and the models used to predict the acoustic response of the latter are not applicable here.
